title: NOVOO 67W 3-Port GaN Charger White $21.99, with USB-C Cable $27.49, Black $27.99 + Del ($0 with Prime) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: NOVOO 67W 3-Port GaN Charger White $21.99, with USB-C Cable $27.49, Black $27.99 + Del ($0 with Prime) @ Mbest-AU via Amazon AU

[OBH] 100W one comes up at $40.99? How did you get that price?
[jaboday423] OP has to update the link in "Go to deal" button as it points to 100W but the deal is for 67W chargers
[OBH] My bad, misread as $5.50 extra for the 100W one
[OzByte] The white Novoo 100w is currently $35.99 without the cable, seems like a good price, so long as you are only planning on using it for short charging bursts as it overheats.
I have an Anker Prime 100w that I bought 2 years ago for $99 it is still market leading size, safe and reputable. In recent sales the Anker is now around the $75 mark.
I also have the Novoo 67w going strong for the past 6 months, bought it after watching a full electrical engineering teardown video of the Novoo 67w where the reviewer found it to be very good quality construction and safe for longer term use (cant find the vid unfortunately but the Novoo 67w is legit).
I've found this vid of the Novoo 100w ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HK0eeI-JniQ ) where the reviewer states its really not a true 100w and it overheats within 50 minutes, so the 100w might be rubbish for powering a laptop or anything all day, makes me wary for anything besides phone charging, the 100w may not be the same high quality as the 67w. The reviewer also stated the Novoo 120w is complete junk fwiw.
